In this AI Makeover, I head to Marbella to help Josh Thomas, the founder of Thomas & Co, one of the fastest growing accountancy firms in the UK, fix the most boring job in his business. 25 of his accountants spend more than half of every working week filling in working papers by hand, over 20 hours a week each, and with the whole industry racing to put AI first, we had four days to build a system that could do it for them. The catch: I've never worked a day of accounting in my life, and by law a human still has to sign off every number.

Four days later we ran the first working paper through it, to see if we'd actually given 25 accountants their week back...
